name: consensus
description: Independent agent answers, bounded debate, and auditable consensus locally or through GitHub Issues.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate local Codex and Claude CLI participants or agents on different computers through GitHub Issues. Preserve independent initial answers, bounded rounds, explicit acceptance and unresolved conclusions.
defaultPrompt: Have Codex and Claude independently answer this task, then debate and summarize.
Start a GitHub agent discussion for this task and return the Issue link.
Join or continue this GitHub consensus Issue.
